official_article32_chinese: 第三十二条 使用人的信息数据或者生物样本开展以下情形的涉及人的生命科学和医学研究，不对人体造成伤害、不涉及敏感个人信息或者商业利益的，可以免除伦理审查，以减少科研人员不必要的负担，促进涉及人的生命科学和医学研究开展。 （一）利用合法获得的公开数据，或者通过观察且不干扰公共行为产生的数据进行研究的；

interpretation.permitted_regulatory_basis: Article32(1) permits exemption for lawfully obtained public-data studies satisfying the preamble conditions: no harm to the human body, no sensitive personal information or commercial interests.
interpretation.not_claimed: No independent approval, waiver, exemption letter, university-office determination, or universal absence of journal/institutional obligations follows from the regulation itself.
interpretation.coded_not_anonymized: Retain coded participant identifiers and no identifying-information access. Do not replace coded with anonymous merely to invoke Article32(2).
interpretation.original_acquisition: Retain original UT Austin protocol2020-03-0073 and original written informed consent as original-study facts; these do not constitute new approval for this secondary analysis.
interpretation.provenance: Historical released evidence remains historical. Amend current submission statements and current containers; do not falsify earlier signed author records or old release checksums.
